item.title: David Teel: Virginia Tech AD Whit Babcock on his future, the Franklin Effect and more
item.description: On the job for a dozen years, longer than any of his ACC peers except soon-to-be retired Bubba Cunningham at North Carolina, Babcock was optimistic, reflective and remorseful.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for January 29, 2026
item.description: Being thoughtful doesn't have to cost a thing! Today, in particular, it's easier than usual to reconnect, mend rifts, and generally be good to one another. That's thanks to Mercury conjoining Venus at 5:17 am EST, coloring the whole day with generous affection. Later, the emotional Moon challenges elusive Neptune, signifying that mixed signals could blur plans or expectations. To avoid issues, we should stop and ask questions whenever confusion arises. item.title: TikTok star Shirley Raines, known for bringing meals and respect to people on LA’s Skid Row, dies at 58
item.description: Raines began working with homeless communities in 2017.

item.title: James City County police officers shoot and kill man inside York County Home Depot
item.description: Two James City County police officers shot and killed a man Wednesday afternoon who they said was coming after them with a claw hammer inside a Home Depot in York County, according to York-Poquoson Sheriff Ron Montgomery.

item.title: Virginia Wesleyan men, CNU women pick up basketball victories
item.description: TJ East scored a game-high 22 points and made 11 of 12 free throws to lead VWU to a come-from-behind ODAC victory at Hampden-Sydney.

item.title: ODU jumps ahead early, holds off Arkansas State to end string of tight losses
item.description: Jordan Battle scored 20 points and made 5 of 8 3-point attempts, including a half-court shot to close the first half, and KC Shaw added 16 points and two late free throws.

item.title: Riley Stack’s career night lifts ODU women to lopsided win over ULM
item.description: Stack continued a recent tear, scoring in double figures for the ninth time in the past 12 games.

item.title: High school scoreboard: No. 4 Norview outscores No. 12 Granby in Eastern District basketball
item.description: Top-ranked Grassfield won their final wrestling meet of the regular season by sweeping Cape Henry Collegiate 67-0.
